name: runtime-bilinear
why: A2's switch has to come from the engine's option registry, not options.txt. The probe scans OptionID 0..1023 for the `upscaling_mode` save tag and calls Option::load("1") on the client thread; this profile only counts taau declarations *after* that call, so taau running normally beforehand is not a failure. Dwell 25 s gives the renderer time to rebuild and to log a period.
